title: Composing a bi-Lipschitz immersed piece with a bi-Lipschitz immersion of ℝ^P
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, F : ℝ^n → ℝ^P L-Lipschitz, B ⊆ ℝ^n, m > 0 with m|a − a'| ≤ |F(a) − F(a')| for all a, a' ∈ B, and F differentiable with injective derivative DF(a) at every a ∈ B. Let φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be differentiable everywhere with Dφ(x) injective for every x, Λ-Lipschitz and Λ'-antilipschitz (|x − y| ≤ Λ'|φ(x) − φ(y)|). Then (i) φ∘F is (ΛL)-Lipschitz; (ii) there is m' > 0 with m'|a − a'| ≤ |φ(F(a)) − φ(F(a'))| for all a, a' ∈ B; (iii) for every a ∈ B, φ∘F is differentiable at a and D(φ∘F)(a) is injective; (iv) for every a ∈ B, range D(φ∘F)(a) = Dφ(F(a))(range DF(a)) (as linear subspaces of ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L Λ Λ' : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L F → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F a - F a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ F a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ F a)) → Differentiable ℝ φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → LipschitzWith Λ φ → AntilipschitzWith Λ' φ → LipschitzWith (Λ * L) (φ ∘ F) ∧ (∃ m' : ℝ, 0 < m' ∧ ∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m' * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖(φ ∘ F) a - (φ ∘ F) a'‖) ∧ (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ ∘ F) a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ F) a)) ∧ ∀ a ∈ B, LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ F) a : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = Submodule.map (fderiv ℝ φ (F a) : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F a : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
